test_cases.description: First-month opening is zero (FORMULA-002 base case). For (design=1, grade=1) with NO ledger rows before 2026-06-01, opening_balance(2026-06-01) returns 0; dashboard row at as_of=2026-06-30 shows opening=0.

On the first day of subsequent month, Opening = Closing of last day of previous month (no manual operation). Insert ledger entries through May 2026; query dashboard at as_of=2026-06-01 — opening must equal May 31 closing balance.

expected_output.note: Opening==Closing because no June movements yet

test_cases.description: Closing for any date equals Opening + cumulative Inward − cumulative Outward + cumulative Adjust within the current month up to that date. Multi-row June 2026 sequence.

Edge — Closing invariant holds when as_of_date is mid-month and some ledger rows fall AFTER as_of_date (those rows MUST be excluded from inward/outward/adjust sums + must not affect closing returned).
Performance — Dashboard p95 < 500ms with 12 months of accumulated transactions (≈4000 ledger rows for 6 active pairs). Validates DS-016 single CASE-aggregated SUM + ix_stock_ledger_dgt index plan.

test_cases.description: LedgerAggregatesRepository.sum_deltas_by_source_type returns one Row per (design, grade) with inward_sum / outward_sum / adjust_sum from the CASE-aggregated GROUP BY. outward_sum is the SUM of -delta for source_type='sale' (reads positive).
Edge — LedgerAggregatesRepository.sum_deltas_by_source_type with empty date window (no ledger rows in range) returns empty list.
Edge — outward_sum reads positive even though delta column is negative for sale rows. Verifies the CASE WHEN source_type='sale' THEN -delta branch in DS-016.

Edge — adjust_sum preserves signed values (positive AND negative adjustments). Different from outward which always reads positive — adjust_sum can be negative if a physical_cb < software_cb shrinkage was applied.

DashboardService.list_as_of computes month_first = as_of_date.replace(day=1) and passes (month_first, as_of_date) to the aggregation query. Verified by inspecting the actual repository call arguments.

Edge — DashboardService.list_as_of asserts the invariant opening+inward-outward+adjust==closing per row. Constructing a row where the running_balance was tampered (closing read from ledger doesn't match formula) MUST raise AssertionError (defense-in-depth per LLD §dashboard_service.py).

inputs.scenario: Deliberately insert a ledger row with running_balance != cumulative deltas
